cross_item_pattern.rule: Two mechanical rules, each applied to the option set only. RULE 1 (range items): on an item whose four options are one 'less than X', two 'between' ranges and one 'greater than Z', pick the numerically LOWER of the two 'between' ranges. Applies to 11 items; picks the key on 8 (73% vs 25% chance): hits ASV6a-P1-Q3, ASV6a-P2-Q3, ASV6a-P3-Q6, ASV6b-P1-Q5, ASV6b-P2-Q3, ASV6b-P4-Q3, ASV6b-P4-Q5, ASV6b-P5-Q4; misses ASV6b-P2-Q5, ASV6b-P3-Q2, ASV6b-P3-Q6. RULE 2 (combination items): when each option is a combination of attribute values (trial pair, student pair, solute+conditions), score each option by how many other options share each of its attribute values and pick the highest (the attribute-wise mode; distractors are built by changing one attribute of the key). Decisive on 8 items, picks the key on 6 (75% vs 25%): hits ASV6a-P2-Q5, ASV6a-P4-Q6, ASV6a-P6-Q4, ASV6b-P3-Q4, ASV6b-P5-Q3, ASV6b-P5-Q6; misses ASV6a-P7-Q6 (mode A, key B) and ASV6a-P5-Q3 (A/C tie, both wrong). Ties (2x2 grids) excluded.
